about: Starting stats per class for the Build planner: the front number of the status window is base + floor(per level x (stat level - 1)), per level from data/builds.json stats.perAttrLevel. A stat's level is floor((4 + growth x (level - 1)) / 4) plus the bonus points put in it. Worked out from in-game status windows; a class without numbers here uses the "estimate" class's until someone checks it, and the player can type their own window to correct it. The 5 classes checked (2026-11-25) start the same in 10 of the 12 stats: only DX (8-11) and WT (1120-1200) differ, so the estimate is close.

Cat.checked: 2026-11-21 in game: Primadonna growth 4-1-1-4 at Lv.146, 152 and 160 (every stat matches)

Bunny.checked: 2026-11-25 in game: Duelist growth 4-1-1-4 at Lv.400, 399 bonus points in AP (every stat matches). Same as Cat but DX 8

Sheep.checked: 2026-11-25 in game: Soul Master growth 1-4-4-1 at Lv.372, 371 bonus points in MA (every stat matches). Same as Cat but DX 11, WT 1120

Dragon.checked: 2026-11-25 in game: Priest growth 1-4-4-1 at Lv.306, 305 bonus points in MA (every stat matches). Same as Cat

Fox.checked: 2026-11-25 in game: Archaeologist at Lv.54, 53 bonus points in DA (every stat matches). Same as Cat
